sentences.text: Ct. 19 vs Sg The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 3 February,

2026 
Author: Hiranmay Bhattacharyya
Bench: Hiranmay Bhattacharyya
Item- Wpa 1498 of 2026
 03-02-2026
 7.
 Shafiuddin Mondal & Ors.
 Ct. 19
 Versus
 sg The State of West Bengal & Ors.
 Mr. Debasis Sur
 Mr. Souvik Das
...for the petitioners  Mr. Wasim Ahmed  Mr. Harun Al Rashid  ...for the State

After going through the reply given to the information sought for under the Right to Information Act, 2005, it appears that certain plots of land within mouza Mena, under Police Station Ashokenagar in the District of North 24 Parganas, have been utilized for the purpose of extension of the road.

On a query of this Court as to whether the said plots were utilized pursuant to any acquisition proceeding and whether any compensation amount has been paid to the land owners of such plots,
the learned Advocate appearing for the State prays for some time to take instruction in this regard.

The learned Advocate appearing for the State also raises an objection as to the maintainability of a joint writ petition at the instance of several persons who have not disclosed their jural relationship between themselves in the writ petition.
An accommodation has been sought for on the ground of the learned Advocate for the petitioners.
List this matter under the same heading on February 20, 2026.

(Hiranmay Bhattacharyya, J.)
